# GetFastCalc — Free Online Calculators & Tools

> AI-friendly site overview. Last updated: 2026-07-16. Site: https://getfastcalc.com

GetFastCalc is a free, no-signup collection of online calculators and small utilities for everyday problems.
Coverage: math, finance, health, developer tools, design, date & time, quant/trading, and text utilities.

## Popular tools

- Percentage Calculator: https://getfastcalc.com/tools/finance/percentage-calculator — Calculate percentages, increases, decreases, and more
- BMI Calculator: https://getfastcalc.com/tools/calc/bmi-calculator — Calculate your Body Mass Index instantly
- Compound Interest Calculator: https://getfastcalc.com/tools/finance/compound-interest-calculator — See how your money grows over time with compound interest
- Income Tax Calculator: https://getfastcalc.com/tools/finance/tax-calculator — Calculate income tax for USA, UK, Canada, Australia and more
- Tip Calculator: https://getfastcalc.com/tools/finance/tip-calculator — Calculate tip amount and split the bill instantly
- Loan Calculator: https://getfastcalc.com/tools/finance/loan-calculator — Calculate monthly payments, total interest, and amortization schedule
- Age Calculator: https://getfastcalc.com/tools/time/age-calculator — Find your exact age in years, months, and days
